metadata.description: Black Box Safety internal Claude plugins — site operations, state sales, and AI foundations.

plugins.name: bbs-website
plugins.description: Maintain the BBS website end to end — price list to product page. Skills, agents, and commands for catalog intake, pricing, enrichment, storefront, quote bot, QA, and cross-sell.

plugins.name: bbs-sales
plugins.description: California state sales: log an inbound RFQ, price it and fill the CA compliance packet, and turn a Grainger negotiated price sheet into an agency promotion page with SCPRS buyer segments and the brand compliance gate.

plugins.name: bbs-foundations
plugins.description: Company-wide AI foundations: the BBS way to write CLAUDE.md files (BBSClaudeMDForge), the doctrine every skill inherits, the shared company facts, systems of record, and certification rules that keep every repo and customer folder consistent, and order reconciliation — diagnosing and resolving problems on orders already placed.

plugins.name: claudeforge
plugins.description: Pinned external dependency of bbs-foundations: the generic CLAUDE.md engine (150-line cap, @path chaining, /enhance-claude-md, /sync-claude-md, drift/link/dependency audits). BBS fork of alirezarezvani/ClaudeForge; bbs-claude-md-forge supplies the BBS doctrine on top of it.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Pinned external design skill for anything with a frontend: /impeccable polish, audit, critique, typeset, layout, and 61 deterministic anti-pattern detector rules. Used on customer-facing HTML (dossiers, landing pages, quote bot, storefront). BBS fork of pbakaus/impeccable (v4.3.1); update by syncing the fork from upstream.

plugins.name: superpowers-chrome
plugins.description: Commons: drives the rep's real Chrome over the DevTools protocol (logged-in sessions, product research on distributor and agency sites). Skill mode needs Node.js (bbs-setup.ps1 installs it). Upstream self-labels beta; pinned to a release tag, refreshed quarterly per docs/COMMONS.md.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Commons: terse output mode (/caveman lite|full|ultra) that cuts roughly two-thirds of output tokens while keeping technical content exact. Opt-in per session; ruled in 2026-09-13. Pinned to a release tag.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Commons: Anthropic's official document skills — Word (tracked changes, comments), PDF (extract, merge, fill, annotate), Excel (formulas, charts). RFQ worksheets, bid PDFs, price lists. Pinned to a commit of anthropics/skills; pptx deliberately excluded.
